decisions.decision: bkg-core is the authoritative buildable tree; bkg-extension-system remains the canonical source for the libraries
decisions.rationale: bkg-extension-system/apps/* are older wrappers of the same plugins. Merging the tool-registering wrappers with packages/* into one workspace makes the dangling node_modules/@bkg/* symlinks resolve, so a real build path exists. The runtime dist was hand-copied and was weeks behind the source.
decisions.consequence: The three plugin defects were only discoverable by building, because nothing in the old layout was buildable.

decisions.rationale: packages/plan-engine-server imports bun builtins (import { $ } from 'bun'). OpenCode executes plugins on Bun.
decisions.consequence: The bundle is not Node-compatible. That is acceptable given the host runtime, but it is a hard coupling worth recording.

decisions.decision: Plugins wrapped loadCommands in try/catch that returned undefined
decisions.rationale: This hid the bkg-team ReferenceError entirely: the plugin loaded, reported no error, and registered zero commands. Six slash commands were silently unavailable.
decisions.consequence: Silent capability loss in every plugin. Worth treating registration failures as observable rather than swallowed.

decisions.decision: Do not delete plugins/bkg-oc-plugin despite the size
decisions.rationale: It is a distinct snapshot (429 MB, 423 MB of it node_modules), not a byte-identical duplicate. Deleting it would have removed a rollback path with no evidence that it is redundant.
decisions.consequence: Disk is not reclaimed. Reclaim only after confirming nothing depends on it.

decisions.decision: Add soniaschu as a second remote for web-mcp rather than replacing origin
decisions.rationale: origin points at AgriciDaniel/web-mcp and is reachable. Repointing it would have silently severed the upstream relationship.
decisions.consequence: Both remotes exist; `git push` with no args now targets soniaschu because that branch tracks it. Push to a named remote until this is revisited.
